claim: With daysPerYear=365 the incidence rate comes out 451, not 451.55.
reason: An integer annualization constant made the SQL numerator all-integer, so the division was integer division (1095000/2425 = 451) instead of numeric. The 365.25 default only worked because the decimal silently coerced the arithmetic to numeric.
suggestedCorrect: Force numeric arithmetic regardless of whether the constant is an integer.

resolution.notes: Render the person-time constant as a decimal literal (e.g. 365.0) so the rate arithmetic is always numeric. Locked in as a permanent regression guard.
